Install and run the rig as your normal user, not root: Claude Code refuses to bypass permissions as root or under sudo.
Set up a clone of openrig, add this repository's context pack, and run the install from the root of that clone.
The first time on a machine, each Claude seat stops at Claude Code's bypass-permissions warning: open the seat (rig opens the TUI) and accept it. Claude Code then remembers it on this machine.
